name: Decoupled Toolbox for Group Content Menu
description: Adds features from Group Content Menu to Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Group Content Menu is a nested sub-module (under Decoupled Toolbox for Group). It registers an event subscriber (MenuLinkTreeBuilder) on the parent renderer's per-entity-type rendered-output event for `group_content_menu` entities, building the menu link tree into the decoupled output so group content menus can be exposed as structured JSON. Requires the contrib Group Content Menu module.
